Check your forehead first
Bell's Palsy vs Stroke
eyebrow: Facial Drooping, What the Forehead Reveals

items.name: Forehead Gets Signals From Both Sides

closing.headline: One side of your face drooping? Look in a mirror and try wrinkling your forehead.
closing.tip: Forehead drooping plus limb weakness — go to the ER. Bell's palsy needs treatment within 72 hours.
closing.cta: Any doubt it might be a stroke? Don't wait — go to the ER immediately.
